paragraphs: The statements in this report include forward-looking statements within the meaning of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. These forward-looking statements are based on current expectations and beliefs and involve numerous risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially from expectations. These forward-looking statements speak only as of the date hereof or as of the dates indicated in the statements and should not be relied upon as predictions of future events, as we cannot assure you that the events or circumstances reflected in these statements will be achieved or will occur. You can identify forward-looking statements by the use of forward-looking terminology including "believes," "expects," "may," "will," "should," "seeks," "intends," "plans," "pro forma," "estimates," "anticipates," or the negative of these words and phrases, other variations of these words and phrases or comparable terminology. The forward-looking statements relate to, among other things: possible impact of future accounting rules on AMD's consolidated financial statements; demand for AMD's products; AMD's strategy and expected benefits; the growth, change and competitive landscape of the markets in which AMD participates; international sales will continue to be a significant portion of total sales in the foreseeable future; the expectation that AMD's cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments together with the availability under that certain revolving credit facility (the Revolving Credit Agreement) made available to AMD and certain of its subsidiaries, our commercial paper program, and our cash flows from operations will be sufficient to fund AMD's operations, including capital expenditures, purchase and lease commitments and strategic activities over the next 12 months and beyond; AMD's ability to obtain sufficient external financing on favorable terms, or at all; AMD's expectation that based on management's current knowledge, the potential liability related to AMD's current litigation will not have a material adverse effect on its financial position, results of operation or cash flows; anticipated ongoing and increased costs related to enhancing and implementing information security controls; revenue allocated to remaining performance obligations that are unsatisfied which will be recognized in the next 12 months; a small number of customers will continue to account for a substantial part of AMD's revenue and receivables in the future; the expected implications from the development of the legal and regulatory environment relating to emerging technologies such as AI; AMD's expectation to utilize the cloud service capacity in its operations or assign the capacity; AMD's expectation that it will not pay dividends in the near future; AMD's ability to achieve its corporate responsibility initiatives; expected future AI technology trends and developments; the expected benefits of AMD's acquisitions; and AMD's expectation to fund stock repurchases through cash generated from operations. For a discussion of the factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from the forward-looking statements, see "Part I, Item 1A—Risk Factors" and the "Financial Condition" section set forth in "Part II, Item 7-Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations," or MD&A, and such other risks and uncertainties as set forth below in this report or detailed in our other Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) reports and filings. We assume no obligation to update forward-looking statements.

Additionally, we make certain voluntary disclosures in this report and on our website, which are informed by various standards and frameworks (including standards for the measurement of underlying data), and the interests of various stakeholders. As such, these voluntary disclosures may not necessarily be "material" under the federal securities laws for SEC reporting purposes. Furthermore, much of this information is subject to methodological considerations or information, including from third-parties, that is still evolving and subject to change, and which AMD does not independently verify. For example, our disclosures based on any standards may change due to revisions in framework requirements, availability of information, changes in our business or applicable government policies, or other factors, some of which may be beyond our control.
References in this Annual Report on Form 10-K to "AMD," "we," "us," "management," "our" or the "Company" mean Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. and our consolidated subsidiaries.

AMD drives innovation in high performance and AI computing to solve the world's most important challenges. AMD technology powers billions of experiences across cloud and AI infrastructure, embedded systems, AI PCs and gaming. With a broad portfolio of AI-optimized CPUs, GPUs, networking and software, AMD delivers full-stack solutions that help customers turn data into breakthroughs, with the speed and scale needed for a new era of intelligent computing. Our high-performance product portfolios provide differentiated solutions, including semi-custom System-on-Chip (SoCs), adaptive SoCs and accelerated processing units (APUs). For data centers, we offer AI accelerators, microprocessors (CPUs), graphic processing units (GPUs), data processing units (DPUs), AI Network Interface Cards (AI NICs) and field programmable gate arrays (FPGAs). We offer ultra-low latency networking solutions. We also offer data center rack-scale platform designs that incorporate AMD data center products to meet the growing performance demands of AI supercomputers and machine learning workloads. In client computing, our CPUs, APUs and chipsets for desktops and notebooks deliver performance, efficiency, AI capabilities and modern security features for gamers, creators, consumers and enterprises. AMD was the first company to integrate a dedicated neural processing unit (NPU) on the same SoC as an x86 CPU for AI PCs. By bringing NPU‑accelerated AI capabilities directly into mainstream x86 platforms, we established a differentiated technology footprint that supports a growing ecosystem of AI‑enabled applications and lays the groundwork for the multi‑generation Ryzen™ AI roadmap that continues to expand our leadership. Our GPUs, including discrete GPUs and semi-custom SoCs, are combined with software to power immersive gaming experiences across PCs, game consoles and cloud gaming services. Our embedded computing portfolio delivers high-performance, scalable solutions across CPUs, APUs, FPGAs, System-on-Modules (SOMs) and adaptive SoCs for markets such as automotive, industrial, healthcare, storage and networking with integrated AI processing capabilities.

We develop comprehensive software stacks that include development tools, compilers and drivers to enable our high-performance CPUs, APUs, GPUs and FPGAs. We have a comprehensive and open AI software stack to support the diverse set of AI ecosystems across frameworks, large and small language models and applications. By working closely with customers, we deliver customized solutions that meet their evolving needs, leveraging our broad IP portfolio and leadership in design, integration and advanced packaging. Our investments in technologies such as our custom-ready chiplet platform and AMD Infinity Fabric™ switch position us to maintain our leadership as a custom-design silicon provider of choice.

We believe AI is shaping the next era of computing and its full potential will be realized when it becomes pervasive across cloud, edge and endpoint devices. With our compute engines, intellectual property, software enablement and deep expertise, AMD is positioned to lead in this next computing era. Our broad portfolio spans supercomputing, cloud, edge, embedded and end devices, providing the unique opportunity to make AMD the end-to-end AI leader.

In 2025, a key priority was accelerating growth in our Data Center segment. Demand for our data center AI accelerator products was strong as large hyperscale customers, OEMs and ODMs deployed our AMD Instinct™ MI350X Series GPUs. We advanced our AMD AI GPU roadmap to deliver an annual cadence of leadership for AMD Instinct solutions, beginning with the AMD Instinct MI350 Series GPUs in 2025. Beyond GPUs, we launched the 5th Gen AMD EPYC™ family of server processors in 2025, which deliver leadership performance and capabilities for a wide range of data center workloads, including AI. In addition, we previewed our "Helios" AI rack-scale platform solution that incorporates all of our data center products (CPUs, GPUs and Networking) to address the growing AI compute requirements.

We strengthened our AI leadership through a number of strategic acquisitions during the year. In March 2025, we acquired ZT Group Int'l, Inc. (ZT Systems), where we retained certain intellectual property and employees associated with the design operations (ZT Design Business). This acquisition enables us to deliver end-to-end AI solutions and accelerate the design and deployment of AMD-powered AI infrastructure at scale optimized for the cloud. In October 2025, we sold the ZT data center infrastructure manufacturing business (ZT Manufacturing Business) to Sanmina Corporation (Sanmina). We made other strategic acquisitions during the year to advance our software capabilities and enable highly optimized solutions across the stack, support co-packaged optics solutions for next-generation AI systems, and bring deep expertise in high-speed inference and reasoning-based AI technologies for large-scale deployments.

We believe that AI systems will require not only powerful chips, but also full-stack innovation across compute, networking, systems architecture and software. AMD is uniquely positioned to deliver across this stack, combining industry-leading CPUs, GPUs and adaptive SoCs with networking, software and system integration expertise. We continue to invest in software capabilities and the open ecosystem through the AMD ROCm™ platform, delivering new features for high-performance AI training and inference. In 2025, we introduced key optimizations and expanded support for frameworks and libraries, improving performance for generative AI workloads and simplifying the developer experience.

In October 2025, we entered into a product purchase agreement with OpenAI OpCo, LLC, (OpenAI) to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs, with the deployment of the first gigawatt of capacity powered by our AMD Instinct MI450 series products. This multiyear strategic partnership with OpenAI demonstrates our continued execution of hardware, software and full-stack solutions roadmaps.

Beginning in the first quarter of fiscal year 2025, we combined the Client and Gaming segments into one reportable segment to align with how we manage our business. All prior period segment data were retrospectively adjusted.
•the Data Center segment, which primarily includes AI accelerators, CPUs for servers, GPUs, APUs, DPUs, AI NICs, FPGAs and SoC products for data centers;
•the Client and Gaming segment, which primarily includes CPUs, APUs, chipsets for desktops and notebooks, discrete GPUs, and semi-custom SoC products and development services; and
•the Embedded segment, which primarily includes embedded CPUs, APUs, FPGAs, SOMs, and adaptive SoC products.

headings: Merger, Acquisition, Divestiture, and Integration Risks
The markets in which our products are sold are highly competitive and rapidly evolving.

The semiconductor industry is highly cyclical and has experienced severe downturns that have materially adversely affected, and may continue to materially adversely affect, our business in the future.
The loss of a significant customer may have a material adverse effect on us.
Economic and market uncertainty may adversely impact our business and operating results.
Our operating results are subject to quarterly and seasonal sales patterns.
Unfavorable currency exchange rate fluctuations could adversely affect us.

We rely on third parties to manufacture our products, and if they are unable to do so on a timely basis in sufficient quantities and using competitive technologies, our business could be materially adversely affected.
If essential equipment, materials, substrates or manufacturing processes are not available to manufacture our products, we could be materially adversely affected.
Failure to achieve expected manufacturing yields for our products could negatively impact our results of operations.
Our revenue from our semi-custom SoC products is dependent upon our semi-custom SoC products being incorporated into customers' products and the success of those products.
Our products may be subject to security vulnerabilities that could have a material adverse effect on us.
Uncertainties involving the ordering and shipment of our products could materially adversely affect us.
Our ability to design and introduce new products in a timely manner includes the use of third-party intellectual property.
We depend on third-party companies for the design, manufacture and supply of motherboards, software, memory and other computer platform components to support our business and products.

If we lose Microsoft Corporation's support for our products or other software vendors do not design and develop software to run on our products, our ability to sell our products could be materially adversely affected.
Our reliance on third-party distributors and AIB partners subjects us to certain risks.

Our business depends on the proper functioning of our internal business processes and information systems and modification or interruption of such systems may disrupt our business, processes and internal controls.
paragraphs: The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. If any of the following risks actually occurs, our business, financial condition or results of operations could be materially adversely affected. In addition, you should consider the interrelationship and compounding effects of two or more risks occurring simultaneously.
The following is a summary of the principal risks that could adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
•The markets in which our products are sold are highly competitive and rapidly evolving.
•The semiconductor industry is highly cyclical and has experienced severe downturns.
•The demand for our products depends in part on the market conditions in the industries into which they are sold.

•The success of our business depends on our ability to introduce products on a timely basis with features and performance levels that provide value to our customers while supporting significant industry transitions.

paragraphs: The following discussion should be read in conjunction with the Consolidated Financial Statements as of December 27, 2025 and December 28, 2024 and for each of the three years in the period ended December 27, 2025 and related notes, which are included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K as well as with the other sections of this Annual Report on Form 10-K, "Part II, Item 8: Financial Statements and Supplementary Data."

In this section, we will describe the general financial condition and the results of operations of Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. and its wholly-owned subsidiaries (collectively, "us," "our" or "AMD"), including a discussion of our results of operations for 2025 compared to 2024, an analysis of changes in our financial condition and a discussion of our off-balance sheet arrangements. Discussions of 2023 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2024 and 2023 that are not included in this Form 10-K can be found in "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" in Part II, Item 7 of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 28, 2024.

Beginning in the first quarter of fiscal year 2025, we combined the Client and Gaming segments into one reportable segment to align with how we manage our business. All prior period segment data were retrospectively adjusted.

In 2025, we delivered strong annual revenue growth with net revenue increasing 34% to $34.6 billion, compared to $25.8 billion in 2024. This growth was driven by the performance of our Data Center and Client and Gaming segments. Data Center net revenue of $16.6 billion increased by 32% compared to $12.6 billion in 2024, primarily driven by strong demand for our 5th generation AMD EPYC™ processors and AMD Instinct™ MI350 Series GPUs. Client and Gaming segment net revenue of $14.6 billion in 2025 increased by 51% compared to $9.6 billion in 2024, primarily driven by strong demand for our AMD Ryzen™ processors, semi-custom game consoles SoCs and Radeon™ gaming GPUs. The increase in annual net revenue was partially offset by a decrease in net revenue in our Embedded segment. Embedded net revenue of $3.5 billion decreased by 3% compared to net revenue of $3.6 billion in 2024, as certain end market demand remained mixed.

Gross margin of 50% increased by 1% compared to 49% in 2024, primarily due to product mix partially offset by approximately $440 million of net inventory and related charges associated with the U.S. government export control on AMD Instinct™ MI308 Data Center GPU products.

Cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments as of December 27, 2025 were $10.6 billion, compared to $5.1 billion at the end of 2024. Our aggregate principal amount of total debt as of December 27, 2025 was $3.3 billion, compared to $1.8 billion as of December 28, 2024.

In 2025, we returned a total of $1.3 billion to shareholders through the repurchase of 12.4 million shares of common stock under our stock repurchase program. As of December 27, 2025, $9.4 billion remained available for future stock repurchases under this program. The stock repurchase program does not obligate us to acquire any common stock, has no termination date and may be suspended or discontinued at any time.

During 2025, we launched multiple leadership products and made significant progress executing our AI strategy. A priority in 2025 was accelerating growth in the Data Center segment. Demand for our data center AI GPU products was strong as large hyperscale customers, OEMs and ODMs deployed our AMD Instinct MI350X Series GPUs. We advanced our AMD AI GPU roadmap to deliver an annual cadence of leadership for AMD Instinct solutions, beginning with the AMD Instinct MI350 Series GPUs in 2025. Beyond GPUs, we launched the 5th Gen AMD EPYC family of server processors in 2025, which deliver leadership performance and capabilities for a wide range of data center workloads, including AI. We also expanded the data center portfolio with new networking solutions, including the AMD Pensando™ "Pollara" 400 AI NICs and "Vulcano" AI NICs, which deliver high-speed connectivity across GPU clusters providing high-performance, AI-ready, flexible solutions for scale-out networking. In addition, we previewed our Helios AI rack-scale platform solution that incorporates all of our data center products (CPUs, GPUs and Networking) to address the growing AI compute requirements.

Across Client and Gaming, we continued to strengthen our leadership with expanding enterprise adoption and a growing portfolio of AMD Ryzen processors. For gamers, creators and developers, we brought to market AMD Radeon 9000 Series GPUs and Radeon AI PRO 9700 GPUs based on the AMD RDNA 4 graphics architecture to market along new high-performance Ryzen Threadripper™ 9000 Series processors. Our x86 Embedded portfolio continued to expand in 2025 with the introduction of three new AMD EPYC embedded processor series: AMD EPYC Embedded 9005 Series, EPYC Embedded 4005 Series and EPYC Embedded 2005 Series.

We also made strategic investments through acquisitions to further advance our software capabilities including compiler and AI expertise in machine learning, inference and performance optimization, and enable highly optimized solutions across the stack; to scale our ability to support and develop a variety of photonics and co-packaged optics solutions across next-gen AI systems; and to bring deep expertise in high-speed inference and reasoning-based AI technologies for large-scale deployments, reinforcing our enterprise AI software stack.

To execute our AI strategy, we brought in multiple AI teams across AMD to drive development of a comprehensive software ecosystem spanning our full product portfolio. We delivered key optimizations and expanded framework and library support in the latest version of AMD ROCm™ software, improving performance for generative AI workloads and simplifying the developer experience across training and inference.

In March 2025, we completed the acquisition of ZT Systems for $3.2 billion in cash and 8.3 million shares of our common stock. We retained select intellectual property and employees associated with the design operations (ZT Design Business), and in October 2025, we sold the ZT data center infrastructure manufacturing business (ZT Manufacturing Business) to Sanmina Corporation (Sanmina) for $2.4 billion in cash, subject to certain purchase price adjustments, and 1.2 million shares of Sanmina common stock. We are eligible to receive additional contingent cash consideration of up to $450 million from Sanmina to the extent certain conditions are met. Sanmina will also be our preferred partner for manufacturing capabilities in building complex AI solutions. Following the close of the sale of the ZT Manufacturing Business to Sanmina, we retained certain intellectual property and former employees of ZT Systems (ZT Design Business) and settled the contingent consideration liability with the former ZT shareholders and warrant holders.

In October 2025, we entered into a product purchase agreement with OpenAI OpCo, LLC, (OpenAI) to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs, with the deployment of the first gigawatt of capacity powered by our AMD Instinct MI450 series products. Concurrent with the agreement, we issued to OpenAI a warrant to purchase up to an aggregate of 160 million shares of AMD's common stock at an exercise price of $0.01 per share. The warrant shares will vest in tranches based on certain AMD Instinct GPU purchase milestones by OpenAI, or its affiliates, or indirectly through third parties, and achievement of specified AMD stock price targets and stock performance. Each vested tranche is further subject to the fulfillment of certain other technical and commercial conditions prior to exercise. Subject to certain conditions, the warrant is exercisable through October 5, 2030. None of the warrant shares met the vesting or exercise conditions and the warrant had no impact to our financial statements for the year ended December 27, 2025.

During the second quarter of fiscal year 2025, the Company recorded approximately $800 million of inventory and related charges on AMD Instinct MI308 Data Center GPU products due to new U.S. export restrictions on certain semiconductors to China. We applied for and were granted some licenses by the U.S. government that allow us to ship MI308 products to certain China-based customers. During the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2025, we began shipping products and reversed approximately $360 million of the inventory and related charges recorded earlier in the year. U.S. government officials have expressed an expectation that the U.S. government will receive 15% of the revenue generated from licensed MI308 sales to China; however, to date, the U.S. government has not published a regulation establishing such requirement.

paragraphs: 本報告中的陳述包括1995年私人證券訴訟改革法項下所指的前瞻陳述。這些前瞻陳述基於目前的期望和信念，並涉及多種風險和不確定性，可能會導致實際結果與期望有顯著差異。這些前瞻陳述僅限於本報告日期或本報告中陳述的日期，不應被視為對未來事件的預測，因為我們不能保證這些陳述中反映的事件或情況將會實現或發生。您可以通過使用前瞻性的詞彙來識別前瞻陳述，包括"認為"、"預期"、"可能"、"將"、"應該"、"尋求"、" intends"、"計劃"、"pro forma"、"估計"、"預期"或這些詞彙和短語的否定形式、其他這些詞彙和短語的變體或相應的詞彙。這些前瞻陳述涉及其他方面，包括：未來會計規則可能對AMD合併財務報表的可能影響；AMD產品的需求；AMD的策略和預期的效益；AMD參與的市場的增長、變化和競爭環境；國際銷售將繼續成為總銷售額的重要部分；我們預期AMD的現金、現金等價物和短期投資，加上根據某特定循環信貸協議（循環信貸協議）向AMD及其某些子公司提供的可用性，以及我們的商業紙張計劃和我們的營運現金流，將足以支持AMD的運作，包括未來12個月及以上的資本支出、購買和租賃承諾以及戰略活動；AMD能夠以有利條件或全部取得足夠的外部融資；AMD預期根據目前的管理知識，與AMD當前訴訟相關的潛在責任不會對其財務狀況、營運結果或現金流量產生重大不利影響；預期未來與增強和實施信息安全控制相關的持續和增加的成本；預期未來12個月內將認定的未滿足履行義務的收入；一小部分客戶將繼續在未來對AMD的收入和應收帳款產生重大影響；預期與新興技術如人工智能的法律和監管環境發展相關的影響；AMD預期將利用其運作中的雲服務容量或分配容量；AMD預期在近期內不會支付股息；AMD實現其企業責任計劃的能力；預期未來的人工智能技術趨勢和發展；預期AMD收購的效益；以及AMD預期通過營運產生的現金來資金回購股票。如需討論可能導致實際結果與前瞻陳述有顯著差異的因素，請參見"第一部分，第1A項—風險因素"以及"第二部分，第7項—管理層對財務狀況和營運結果的討論和分析"或管理層討論和分析（MD&A）部分，或本報告中詳述的其他風險和不確定性，或詳述在我們其他證券和期貨交易委員會（SEC）報告和申報中。我們不承擔更新前瞻陳述的義務。

此外，我們在本報告和我們的網站上作出某些自願披露，這些披露基於各種標準和框架（包括基數數據的測量標準），以及各種利益相關者的利益。因此，這些自願披露可能不一定根據聯邦證券法規在SEC報告目的下被視為"重要"。此外，許多此信息受方法論考慮或信息，包括來自第三方的信息，仍在演變和可能會改變，而AMD並不獨立驗證。例如，基於任何標準的披露可能會由於框架要求的修訂、信息的可獲取性、我們業務或適用政府政策的變化，或其他因素而發生變化，其中一些因素可能超出我們的控制。
本年度報告中的「AMD」、「我們」、「我們」、「管理層」、「我們」或「本公司」指的是 Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. 及其合併子公司。

AMD 驅動高性能和人工智能計算的創新，以解決世界最重要的挑戰。AMD 技術推動數十億種體驗在雲端和人工智能基礎設施、嵌入式系統、人工智能個人電腦和遊戲中運行。我們擁有廣泛的人工智能優化 CPU、GPU、網路和軟體的產品組合，為客戶提供端到端的解決方案，幫助他們將數據轉換為突破，以滿足新時代智能計算所需的速度和規模。我們的高性能產品組合提供差異化的解決方案，包括半自訂系統級晶片 (SoC)、自適應 SoC 和加速處理單元 (APU)。對於資料中心，我們提供人工智能加速器、微處理器 (CPU)、圖形處理器 (GPU)、數據處理器 (DPU)、人工智能網路接口卡 (AI NIC) 和現場可編程門陣列 (FPGA)。我們提供超低延遲網路解決方案。我們還提供資料中心機架級平台設計，整合 AMD 資料中心產品，以滿足人工智能超級計算機和機器學習工作負載的增長性能需求。在客戶計算中，我們的 CPU、APU 和桌面和筆記本電腦的晶片組提供性能、效率、人工智能功能和現代安全特性，以滿足遊戲者、創作者、消費者和企業的需求。AMD 是第一家在同一個 SoC 上集成功能專門的人工智能處理單元 (NPU) 的 x86 CPU 的公司。通過將 NPU 加速的人工智能功能直接整合到主流 x86 平台中，我們確立了一個差異化的技術足跡，支持日益增長的人工智能啟用應用程序生態系統，並為我們的多代 Ryzen™ AI 路線圖奠定了基礎，該路線圖繼續擴展我們的領導地位。我們的 GPU，包括離散 GPU 和半自訂 SoC，與軟體結合，推動 PC、遊戲機和雲端遊戲服務中的沉浸式遊戲體驗。我們的嵌入式計算產品組合提供跨 CPU、APU、FPGA、系統級模塊 (SOM) 和自適應 SoC 的高性能、可擴展解決方案，以滿足汽車、工業、醫療保健、存儲和網路市場的應用，這些市場具有整合的人工智能處理能力。

本公司開發全面的軟體堆疊，包括開發工具、編譯器和驅動程序，以啟用我們高性能的CPU、APU、GPU和FPGA。我們有一個全面且開放的人工智慧軟體堆疊，以支持跨框架、大型和小型語言模型以及應用的多種人工智能生態系統。通過與客戶密切合作，我們交付量身訂製的解決方案，以滿足他們不斷變化的需要，利用我們廣泛的智慧財產權和在設計、整合和先進封裝方面的領導地位。我們在自訂就緒的晶片平台和AMD Infinity Fabric™交換機上的投資使我們能夠保持作為自訂設計硅片供應商的領導地位。
我們認爲人工智能正在塑造計算的下一個時代，並且當它在雲端、邊緣和終端設備中普及時，其全部潛力將會實現。通過我們的計算引擎、智慧財產權、軟體啟用和深厚專業知識，AMD 有地位成為下一個計算時代的領先者。我們廣泛的產品線涵蓋超級計算、雲端、邊緣、嵌入式和終端設備，為成為端到端的人工智慧領導者提供了獨特的機會。

在2025年，一個重要的優先事項是加速我們資料中心分部的增長。我們的人工智慧加速器產品需求旺盛，因為大型超大規模客戶、OEM和ODM部署了我們的AMD Instinct™ MI350X系列GPU。我們推進了AMD的人工智慧GPU路線圖，以實現每年一次的領導地位，從2025年的AMD Instinct MI350系列GPU開始。除了GPU，我們在2025年推出了第5代AMD EPYC™系列伺服器處理器，這為一系列資料中心工作負載提供了領先的性能和功能，包括人工智能。此外，我們預覽了我們的"Helios" AI機架級平台解決方案，該解決方案整合了我們的所有資料中心產品（CPU、GPU和網路）以應對不斷增長的人工智慧計算需求。

通過在一年中進行多項戰略收購，我們增強了在人工智能方面的領導地位。在2025年3月，我們收購了ZT Group Int'l, Inc.（ZT Systems），我們保留了與設計操作（ZT Design Business）相關的某些智慧財產權和員工。這次收購使我們能夠交付端到端的人工智慧解決方案，並加速AMD供應的人工智慧基礎設施的設計和部署，以滿足雲端的規模化優化。在2025年10月，我們將ZT資料中心基礎設施製造業務（ZT Manufacturing Business）出售給Sanmina Corporation（Sanmina）。我們在一年中進行了其他戰略收購，以推進我們的軟體能力，並在堆疊中啟用高度優化的解決方案，支持下一代人工智能系統的共裝光學解決方案，並帶來在大規模部署中對高速推理和推理基於的人工智慧技術的深厚專業知識。

我們認為，AI系統將需要不僅強大的晶片，還需要在計算、網路、系統架構和軟體方面進行全棧創新。AMD在這個堆疊中獨特地處於有利位置，通過結合業界領先的CPU、GPU和自適應SoC，以及網路、軟體和系統整合專業知識，來實現這一目標。我們繼續通過AMD ROCm™平台投資軟體能力及開放生態系統，推出新功能以支持高性能AI訓練和推理。在2025年，我們引入了關鍵優化並擴展了對框架和庫的支持，以提高生成式AI工作負載的性能並簡化開發者體驗。
在2025年十月，我們與OpenAI OpCo, LLC（OpenAI）簽署了一項產品購買協議，部署6吉瓦的AMD GPU，並在2025年部署了第一吉瓦的容量，由我們的AMD Instinct MI450系列產品供應。與OpenAI的多年戰略合作顯示了我們繼續執行硬體、軟體和全棧解決方案路線圖的決心。
自2025年財務年度第一季度開始，我們將客戶和遊戲段合併為一個應報告段，以符合我們管理業務的方式。所有往期段數據均回溯調整。
•資料中心段，主要包括AI加速器、伺服器用CPU、GPU、APU、DPU、AI NIC、FPGA和資料中心用SoC產品；
•客戶和遊戲段，主要包括CPU、APU、臺式機和筆記本電腦的晶片組、離散GPU、半自定義SoC產品和開發服務；以及
•嵌入式段，主要包括嵌入式CPU、APU、FPGA、SOM和自適應SoC產品。

paragraphs: 本段落應與2025年12月27日和2024年12月28日合併財務報表，以及2025年12月27日前三個年度的相關附註一併閱讀，這些附註包含於本年度報告的10-K表格中，以及本年度報告的其他部分，"第II部分，第8項：財務報表及附註"。

在本節中，我們將描述Advancd Micro Devices, Inc.及其全資子公司（合稱為"我們"、"我們"或"AMD"）的一般財務狀況和營運結果，包括我們2025年與2024年的營運結果比較、財務狀況變化的分析以及我們的離表安排的討論。本年度報告的10-K表格中未包含的2023年項目和2024年與2023年的年對年比較，請見"管理層對財務狀況和營運結果的討論和分析"，該部分位於本年度報告的10-K表格第II部分，第7項，財務年度截止於2024年12月28日。
自2025年財務年度第一季起，我們將Client和Gaming分部合併為一個應報告分部，以符合我們管理業務的方式。所有往期分部數據均經後向調整。

在2025年，我們實現了強勁的年度營收增長，淨收入增加34%至346億美元，相比2024年的258億美元。這份增長主要由Data Center和Client及Gaming分部的表現驅動。Data Center的淨收入為166億美元，相比2024年的126億美元增長32%，主要受5代AMD EPYC™處理器和AMD Instinct™ MI350系列GPU強勁需求的驅動。Client及Gaming分部的淨收入在2025年為146億美元，相比2024年的96億美元增長51%，主要受AMD Ryzen™處理器、半自定義遊戲主機SoC和Radeon™遊戲GPU強勁需求的驅動。年度淨收入的增長部分被Embedded分部的淨收入下降所抵消。Embedded分部的淨收入在2025年為35億美元，相比2024年的36億美元下降3%，部分原因是某些終端市場需求仍處於混亂狀態。
毛利率從2024年的49%增加1%至50%，主要由於產品結構部分抵消了約4400萬美元的淨存貨及相關費用，該費用與美國政府對AMD Instinct™ MI308資料中心GPU產品的出口管制有關。
截至2025年12月27日，現金、現金等價物和短期投資為106億美元，相比2024年底的51億美元有所增加。截至2025年12月27日，我們的總債務本金總額為33億美元，相比2024年12月28日的18億美元有所增加。
在2025年，我們通過股票回購計劃回購了1240萬股普通股，總計回贈13億美元給股東。截至2025年12月27日，根據此計劃，仍有94億美元可用於未來的股票回購。股票回購計劃不義務我們購買任何普通股，無終止日期，且可在任何時間暫停或終止。

在2025年，我們推出了多個領導力產品，並在執行AI策略方面取得了顯著進展。2025年的優先事項是加速Data Center分部的增長。我們的資料中心AI GPU產品需求強烈，大型超大規模客戶、OEM和ODM部署了我們的AMD Instinct MI350X系列GPU。我們推進了AMD AI GPU路線圖，以實現每年一次的領導地位，從2025年的AMD Instinct MI350系列GPU開始。除了GPU，我們在2025年推出了5代AMD EPYC系列伺服器處理器，這些處理器為廣泛的資料中心工作負載，包括AI，提供了領導地位的性能和能力。此外，我們擴展了資料中心產品組合，推出了新的網路解決方案，包括AMD Pensando™ "Pollara" 400 AI NICs和"Vulcano" AI NICs，這些解決方案提供了高速連接，支持GPU集羣，提供高性能、AI準備、靈活的解決方案，適應於規模擴展網路。此外，我們預覽了我們的Helios AI機架級平台解決方案，該解決方案整合了我們的所有資料中心產品（CPU、GPU和網路），以應對不斷增長的AI計算需求。

在客戶和遊戲領域，我們繼續通過擴大企業採用和增長AMD Ryzen處理器的產品組合來強化我們的領導地位。對於遊戲者、創作者和開發者，我們推出了基於AMD RDNA 4圖形架構的AMD Radeon 9000系列GPU和AMD Radeon AI PRO 9700 GPU，以及新的高性能Ryzen Threadripper™ 9000系列處理器。我們的x86嵌入式產品組合在2025年繼續擴大，引入了三個新的AMD EPYC嵌入式處理器系列：AMD EPYC Embedded 9005系列、EPYC Embedded 4005系列和EPYC Embedded 2005系列。
我們還通過收購進行戰略性投資，以進一步推進我們的軟體能力，包括編譯器和人工智能專家在機器學習、推理和性能優化方面的知識，並使我們能夠在堆棧的各個層面提供高度優化的解決方案；以擴大我們支持和開發下一代光學和共封裝光學解決方案的能力；以及引入在高速推理和基於推理的AI技術方面的深厚專業知識，以支持大規模部署，強化我們的企業人工智能軟體堆棧。
為了執行我們的人工智能策略，我們在AMD內引入了多個AI團隊，driving開發一個全面的軟體生態系統，覆蓋我們的全部產品組合。我們在最新版本的AMD ROCm™軟體中交付了關鍵優化和擴展了框架和庫的支持，提高了生成式人工智能工作負載的性能，並簡化了訓練和推理的開發者體驗。

在2025年3月，我們以32億美元現金和830萬股本公司普通股的價格完成了對ZT Systems的收購。我們保留了與設計操作（ZT Design Business）相關的選擇性智慧財產權和員工。在2025年10月，我們將ZT資料中心基礎設施製造業務（ZT Manufacturing Business）以24億美元現金的價格出售給Sanmina Corporation（Sanmina），條件是根據某些購買價格調整。如果某些條件得到滿足，我們有權從Sanmina獲得至多4.5億美元的附加 contingent cash consideration。Sanmina還將是我們在構建複雜的人工智能解決方案方面的主要製造夥伴。在將ZT Manufacturing Business出售給Sanmina後，我們保留了某些與ZT Systems（ZT Design Business）相關的智慧財產權和前員工，並與前ZT股東和認證持有人解決 contingent consideration責任。

在2025年10月，我們與OpenAI OpCo, LLC（OpenAI）簽署了一項產品採購協議，部署6吉瓦的AMD GPU，並在2025年部署了第一吉瓦的容量，由我們的AMD Instinct MI450系列產品供應。同時，我們向OpenAI發行了一項認證權證，使OpenAI有權以每股0.01美元的行使價格購買至多1.6億股AMD的普通股。認證股權將根據OpenAI、其聯營公司或通過第三方實現某些AMD Instinct GPU採購里程碑、達成指定的AMD股票價格目標和股票表現而分階段授予。每個認證的分期還需滿足某些其他技術和商業條件，方可行使。在某些條件下，認證權證可在2030年10月5日前行使。在截至2025年12月27日的財務年度中，認證股權未達成認證或行使條件，對我們的財務報表沒有影響。

在2025財務年度第二季度，本公司記錄了約8億美元的存貨和相關費用，原因是新出臺的某些半導體對中國的出口限制。我們申請並獲得了某些由美國政府授予的許可，使我們可以向某些中國基於地的客戶發貨MI308產品。在2025財務年度第四季度，我們開始發貨產品，並在年初記錄的約3.6億美元的存貨和相關費用中反轉。美國政府官員表示，他們期望美國政府將從授權向中國銷售的MI308收入中獲得15%；然而，到目前為止，美國政府尚未發布規定此要求的規範。

headings: 併購、收購、剝離及整合風險
我們產品銷售的市場競爭激烈且快速變革。
半導體行業高度週期性，曾經歷嚴重的衰退，對我們的業務造成重大負面影響，未來可能會繼續造成重大負面影響。
失去一位重要客戶可能會對我們產生重大負面影響。
總體經濟和市場不確定性可能會對我們的業務和營運結果產生負面影響。
我們的營運結果受到季度和季節性銷售模式的影響。
不利的貨幣匯率波動可能會對我們產生負面影響。
我們依賴第三方製造我們的產品，如果他們無法在及時足夠的數量和使用競爭力的技術上製造我們的產品，我們的業務可能會受到重大負面影響。
如果我們的關鍵設備、材料、基板或製造過程不可用來製造我們的產品，我們可能會受到重大負面影響。
未能實現我們產品的預期製造產量可能會對我們的營運結果產生負面影響。
我們從半客製SoC產品的收入取決於我們的半客製SoC產品被客戶產品採用以及這些產品的成功。
本公司產品可能會遭受安全漏洞，可能會對我們產生重大不利影響。
本公司產品的訂購和運送的不確定性可能會對我們產生重大不利影響。
本公司能夠及時設計和推出新產品包括使用第三方智慧財產權。
本公司依賴第三方公司為我們的業務和產品設計、製造和供應主機板、軟體、記憶體及其他計算平台零組件。
如果我們失去微軟公司對我們產品的支持，或其他軟體供應商未能設計和開發可在我們產品上運行的軟體，我們銷售產品的能力可能會受到重大不利影響。
本公司依賴第三方銷售商和AIB夥伴使我們面臨某些風險。
本公司業務依賴於本公司內部業務流程和資訊系統的正常運作，這些系統的修改或中斷可能會打斷我們的業務、流程和內部控制。
paragraphs: 本文件中描述的風險和不確定性並非本公司所面臨的唯一風險。如果下列任何風險實際發生，本公司的業務、財務狀況或營業結果可能會受到重大不利影響。此外，您應考慮兩個或多個風險同時發生時的相互關係和複合效應。
以下為可能對本公司業務、財務狀況和營業結果產生不利影響的主要風險摘要。
•本公司產品銷售的市場競爭激烈且快速演變。
•半導體行業高度週期性，曾經歷嚴重的衰退。
•本公司產品的需求部分取決於其銷售的行業的市場條件。
•本公司業務的成功取決於本公司能夠及時推出具有價值於客戶且支持重要行業轉型的產品。
